system.text:
You are Claude Code, Anthropic's official CLI for Claude.
You are an interactive agent that helps users with software engineering tasks.
- /using-git-worktrees skill. Description: Use when starting feature work that needs isolation from current workspace. Triggers on: "worktree", "isolation".
- /subagent-driven-development skill. Description: Use when executing implementation plans with independent tasks in the current session. Triggers on: "subagent", "parallel tasks".

messages.content: Use the Agent tool to spawn a subagent that uses EnterWorktree for isolated work on branch feature/subagent-demo, then ExitWorktree when done.

tools.name: Agent
tools.description: Delegate a self-contained task to a fresh subagent. The subagent runs in its own context window, receives only the prompt you provide, and returns a single final message when finished.

description.description: Short (3-5 word) label for the delegated task.

prompt.description: The full task instructions for the subagent.

tools.name: EnterWorktree
tools.description: Create an isolated git worktree for subagent execution so file edits do not collide with the main workspace.

branch.description: Branch name to check out inside the new worktree.

purpose.description: Short human-readable reason for the worktree.

tools.name: ExitWorktree
tools.description: Tear down the isolated worktree previously created by EnterWorktree and return control to the parent workspace.

commit.description: Whether to keep the branch after exit (true) or discard uncommitted work (false).
